selected_evidence.requirement: Authenticated writable SMB share named projects on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Samba configuration validates, exposes the projects path to @design, is enabled and active, and listens on TCP 445.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 can list, read, and update documents as designer
selected_evidence.summary: Node2 listed the share, read drawing.txt, created and overwrote collaboration-status.txt, and read back the updated content before and after restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: Guest and sibling-directory access are rejected
selected_evidence.summary: Anonymous tree connection returned NT_STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED; traversal toward private/contracts.txt returned NT_STATUS_OBJECT_PATH_NOT_FOUND.
drawing.txt and materials.csv matched their captured pre-change SHA-256 hashes before and after restart testing.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.
Healthy baseline boot ID dfeb3b70-bc1e-4ce9-90d0-9c9c853416e7 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID cb295efe-04eb-49a8-9905-d62a86912316 observed, and Samba/service/data recovery verified.

Healthy baseline boot ID e8afb731-420c-4162-a989-583aca271335 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 73408583-bd1d-4ef4-8669-cb404c4ba259 observed, and authenticated SMB access plus all access boundaries were reverified.

set -eu

test -n "$SMB_PASS"
printf '%s\n%s\n' "$SMB_PASS" "$SMB_PASS" | smbpasswd -a -s designer >/dev/null
unset SMB_PASS
chown -R designer:design /srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/projects
find /srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/projects -type d -exec chmod 2770 {} \;

[global]
   workgroup = WORKGROUP
   server role = standalone server
   security = user
   map to guest = Never
   server min protocol = SMB2
   disable netbios = yes
   log file = /var/log/samba/log.%m
   max log size = 1000

[projects]
   path = /srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/projects
   browseable = yes
   read only = no
   guest ok = no

   force group = design
   create mask = 0660
   force create mode = 0660
   directory mask = 2770
   force directory mode = 2770
ANTRIEB_SMB_EOF
testparm -s /etc/samba/smb.conf
systemctl enable smbd
systemctl restart smbd
systemctl is-active smbd
ss -tlnp | grep ':445 '
sha256sum -c /root/projects.initial.sha256
stat -c '%n %a %U:%G' /srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/projects /srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/projects/* /srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/private /srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/private/contracts.txt

commands.command:
set -eu
SERVER_IP=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node1" {print $1; exit}')
test -n "$SERVER_IP"
CRED=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$CRED" /tmp/node2-project-read.txt /tmp/node2-project-update.txt /tmp/node2-leak.txt' EXIT HUP INT TERM
chmod 600 "$CRED"
printf 'username=designer\npassword=[REDACTED]]] "$SMB_PASS" > "$CRED"
printf '%s\n' '--- authenticated share list ---'
smbclient -L "//$SERVER_IP" -A "$CRED" -m SMB3
printf '%s\n' '--- project directory list ---'
smbclient "//$SERVER_IP/projects" -A "$CRED" -m SMB3 -c 'ls'
printf '%s\n' '--- read original document ---'
smbclient "//$SERVER_IP/projects" -A "$CRED" -m SMB3 -c 'get drawing.txt /tmp/node2-project-read.txt' >/dev/null
cat /tmp/node2-project-read.txt
printf '%s\n' '--- create then update document ---'
printf 'design status: draft\n' > /tmp/node2-project-update.txt
smbclient "//$SERVER_IP/projects" -A "$CRED" -m SMB3 -c 'put /tmp/node2-project-update.txt collaboration-status.txt' >/dev/null
printf 'design status: updated by node2\n' > /tmp/node2-project-update.txt
smbclient "//$SERVER_IP/projects" -A "$CRED" -m SMB3 -c 'put /tmp/node2-project-update.txt collaboration-status.txt; get collaboration-status.txt /tmp/node2-project-read.txt' >/dev/null
cat /tmp/node2-project-read.txt
printf '%s\n' '--- anonymous access must fail ---'
if smbclient "//$SERVER_IP/projects" -N -m SMB3 -c 'ls' >/tmp/guest.out 2>&1; then cat /tmp/guest.out; echo 'ERROR: guest access succeeded'; exit 1; else sed -n '1,5p' /tmp/guest.out; echo 'PASS: guest access rejected'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- sibling traversal must fail ---'
if smbclient "//$SERVER_IP/projects" -A "$CRED" -m SMB3 -c 'get ../private/contracts.txt /tmp/node2-leak.txt' >/tmp/sibling.out 2>&1; then cat /tmp/sibling.out; echo 'ERROR: sibling access succeeded'; exit 1; else sed -n '1,5p' /tmp/sibling.out; test ! -e /tmp/node2-leak.txt; echo 'PASS: sibling access rejected'; fi
rm -f /tmp/guest.out /tmp/sibling.out
